description: This line plot illustrates the similarity scores across different layers for four distinct model configurations, labeled en&es, en&el, and en&bn, as well as a fourth unlabeled red line that appears to represent a baseline or reference model. The x-axis, labeled "Layer," ranges from 0 to 22 in integer increments, indicating the layer index of a neural network. The y-axis, labeled "Similarity," is scaled linearly from 0.00 to 0.45, representing the similarity metric. The red line, which corresponds to the unlabeled baseline, starts at approximately 0.07, rises to a peak of 0.26 at layer 6, then declines to a low of 0.07 around layer 20 before sharply increasing to 0.44 at layer 22. The blue line (en&es) begins at 0.05, rises to 0.25 at layer 6, and then generally declines to 0.04 at layer 22. The green line (en&el) starts at 0.04, peaks at 0.15 around layer 12, and then declines to 0.04 at layer 22. The pink line (en&bn) begins at 0.04, rises to 0.15 around layer 12, and then declines to 0.04 at layer 22. All lines exhibit a general trend of increasing similarity early in the model, followed by a decline, and then a sharp increase in similarity at the final layers.
